scope: Semantic per-value string-byte normalization; real static shipped-application control, no hosted-model performance claim
conditions: First query is after shared artifact analysis; subsequent queries share one MCP session. Legacy item reads are serial; a concurrent legacy baseline is unmeasured. Filesystem/build warmness uncontrolled. Token costs count one post-change catalog, preparation request/summary and each request/structured reply once; client rendering, replay, reasoning, final answer and model latency are unmeasured. Preparation and parity/tokenization overhead are outside per-query elapsed times; external family-resource receipts include the complete verifier and children. Before/after used separate fresh MCP sessions. CPU/memory includes analysis, query arms, export, CLI parity and tokenization; cgroup memory includes file cache, not summed RSS. Counters are at payload exit while observer lives, not final scope counters. One before/after control establishes no speedup or equivalence bound. Catalog BPE projection excludes annotations/output schemas.
